name: Product bundles
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Product bundles.
Select manual products or a collection first. Choose an optional product metafield reference only when you already have a suitable definition.
The section adds selected products as separate cart lines. It does not create a bundle SKU or apply a discount. Configure real automatic discounts separately in Shopify.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.
